k-dcty.title: GTA VI DacityCoin $DCTY coins
k-dcty.sourceSays: Posts say a GTA VI stream showed an in-game crypto app and AudaCity truck pointing to the ticker $DCTY; at least one post calls this a larp and questions the stream.
k-dcty.reason: Nov 18 posts describe the GTA VI in-game DacityCoin/ticker claim and a skeptic disputes it; pools opened hours before, the claim is unverified.

k-audacity.title: Papa Audacity GTA 6 character coins
k-audacity.sourceSays: Posts say Papa Audacity is a fictional GTA 6 crypto influencer who created DacityCoin, and that $PAPA coins follow the character; one post flags wallet clusters.
k-audacity.reason: Posts of Nov 18 tie the PAPA/AudaCity coins to the GTA 6 character Papa Audacity behind DacityCoin; the same GTA 6 story, claims unverified, with a wallet-cluster warning.
